target.title: docs: propose durable session task runtime RFC v2
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw has strong sessions, Gateway, tasks, subagents, and operator surfaces, but long-running multi-agent work still needs a small core contract for durable session/task runtime state: run identity, step identity, event ordering, child links, recovery markers, and read-only inspection.

This PR is the RFC/architecture decision point for that boundary. It replaces the older RFC discussion in #97507 with updated naming and scope:

- `durable_runtime_*` instead of workflow-oriented schema naming;
- runtime runs/steps/events/refs/signals/timers/links as the core primitives;
- local-first shared state DB posture;
- Task Flow, Workboard, Work module, and external PM tools as projections/follow-ups, not prerequisites;
- no product-specific terminology.

## Dependency Chain

This is PR1 in the replacement durable runtime stack:

1. PR1: RFC v2 docs only, this PR.
2. PR2: durable runtime foundation, schema/store/CLI/Gateway read-only inspection.
3. PR3: agent/session/subagent wiring on top of PR2.

PR2 and PR3 should be reviewed only after this boundary is acceptable.

## Scope

Docs only. No runtime behavior changes.

## Validation

- `git diff --check` passed locally before push.

## Notes

The older PRs #97507 and #97508 are intentionally left open while reviewers inspect this replacement stack. They can be closed after the new stack has review feedback.
